QF.id: VI Functions of DP Account Opening_24

question.text: How many types of clearing members are there in the depository system?

answer.text: Two — stock exchange members and custodians permitted by the exchange to act as clearing members
Four — brokers, banks, custodians, and FPIs

explanation.text: The Logic: Two types: (1) All members of a stock exchange are clearing members, and (2) Custodians permitted by the exchange to act as clearing members. The Trap: 'Only stock exchange members' misses the custodian category. Custodians play a crucial role in clearing for institutional investors. Cross-Exam Context: Series VII covers clearing member categories in detail.
